posts.text:
GPT-6.2 Astra is amazing. For $20/month, you can now access a model that surpasses top human intelligence in some domains.

I'm most excited to see what scientific discoveries people are able to make using it.
posts.quoted: GPT-6.2 Astra—a frontier model built for your hardest projects. It sets new highs on evals across professional work and scientific research at less than a third of the cost per task of GPT‑6 Astra. You’ll see the difference in things like slideshows, websites, and 3D designs.
